record.title: Bennet and Welch propose a federal agency with pre-release AI review authority
record.summary: Senators Michael Bennet and Peter Welch announced a proposal for a Federal Digital Commission with oversight powers spanning frontier AI and large digital platforms. Their press release describes proposed pre-certification, a possible pause of certain high-risk model releases, incident-reporting and mitigation duties, and civil penalties up to 15% of prior-year global revenue. This is a proposal described by its sponsors, not an introduced or enacted law; the underlying legislative text was not located in this review.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: On 23 September 2026, U.S. Senators Michael Bennet and Peter Welch publicly announced a proposal to create a Federal Digital Commission with authority over frontier AI and major digital platforms.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The senators' announcement describes proposed pre-certification for frontier AI models, authority to pause public release of a model posing catastrophic risk for up to six months or until safeguards are in place, risk-mitigation and incident-reporting requirements, and civil penalties of up to 15% of a firm's prior-year global revenue.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED_LIMITATION
claims.text: The inspected official source is a press release describing a proposal. This review did not locate an introduced bill number or full legislative text, and the proposal is not evidence of enacted law or implemented oversight.

evidence_gaps.description: The full legislative text and bill number were not located in this review.
The proposal's legislative status and support after the announcement are unknown.

brief.importance_rationale: If the outlined authority were enacted, it could materially change U.S. frontier-model release and compliance requirements. Consequence is meaningful but not major at the present proposal stage: no full bill text, legislative progress or enactment was established.
limitations: The source is an announcement by the proposal's sponsors and does not establish enactment, bipartisan support or likelihood of passage.
A bill number and complete legislative text were not located in the bounded search; linked section-by-section materials were not inspected.
The announced penalty ceiling, review triggers and proposed obligations have not been verified against operative statutory text.
No implementation, developer response or measured effect on model releases is established.
brief.summary: Senators Michael Bennet and Peter Welch announced a proposal for a Federal Digital Commission with oversight powers spanning frontier AI and large digital platforms. Their press release describes proposed pre-certification, a possible pause of certain high-risk model releases, incident-reporting and mitigation duties, and civil penalties up to 15% of prior-year global revenue. This is a proposal described by its sponsors, not an introduced or enacted law; the underlying legislative text was not located in this review.

technical.claimed_result: No model-performance result is claimed. The development is a policy proposal whose announced authorities could affect AI development and deployment if adopted.
technical.demonstrated_result: The official Senate office page establishes that Bennet and Welch announced the proposal and publicly described its intended authorities. It does not establish statutory text or implementation.
technical.mechanism: The proposed commission would review certain frontier models before release, set risk mitigation, incident reporting and transparency requirements, and could pause distribution for up to six months or until safeguards are in place, according to the sponsors' press release.
technical.regime: U.S. federal frontier-AI oversight as described in the sponsors' 23 September 2026 announcement; no introduced bill or enacted regime was identified in this check.
technical.reproducibility: The official announcement is directly inspectable. Full legislative language and subsequent legislative status require additional official-source checks.
technical.strongest_baseline: The proposal builds on earlier Digital Platform Commission proposals; this announcement adds frontier-AI pre-certification and catastrophic-risk release-pause authorities as described by the sponsors.

brief.title: Bennet and Welch propose a federal agency with pre-release AI review authority
brief.why_it_matters: If enacted as described, the proposal would add a federal pre-release review and pause mechanism for some frontier models, changing compliance planning and the path to market for developers. Its current status is an announcement by two senators, so likelihood of enactment and operative legal details remain unknown.
